meta.title: IBSU — Applicants
meta.description: Everything a future IBSU student needs: programmes, admission steps, tuition, scholarships and key dates at International Black Sea University, Tbilisi.

chapters.line: Every story starts with a question.
Then, one day, you go looking for the answer.
Every step, a little taller. Every year, a little braver.
Until you find the place where it all comes together.

hero.title: Georgia’s first English-language university.
hero.lede: Five schools, one courtyard. IBSU brings world-class, practice-based education — and the partnership of MIT, the world’s leading university — to the heart of Tbilisi.

programs.title: Choose the story you want to write.
programs.lede: Bachelor’s programmes across IBSU’s schools. Filter by school to see what fits you.

admission.title: Four steps to your first day.

steps.title: Sit the Unified National Exams
steps.body: Georgian applicants enter IBSU through the Unified National Exams. Register with the National Assessment and Examinations Center (NAEC).

steps.title: Choose IBSU and your programme
steps.body: List IBSU and your chosen programme among your priorities during NAEC registration.

steps.title: Get your results
steps.body: Enrolment is based on your exam scores. Results are published by NAEC.

steps.title: Enrol and sign your contract
steps.body: Bring your documents to IBSU, sign the study contract and join orientation week.

intl.title: Applying from abroad?
intl.body: International applicants apply directly to IBSU with their school certificate and English-language proof. Our admissions team will guide you through recognition and visas.

tuition.title: An investment in your next forty years.
tuition.lede: Tuition depends on the programme. Strong exam results and achievements can unlock discounts and scholarships.

cards.title: Annual tuition
cards.note: Per programme — see the full fee table.

cards.title: Exam-score discounts
cards.note: Based on your Unified National Exam results.

items.q: Are all programmes taught in English?
items.a: IBSU is Georgia’s first English-language university. Language of instruction is listed for each programme in the catalogue.
Georgian applicants take the Unified National Exams; the required subjects depend on the programme you choose.
Yes — IBSU offers discounts and scholarships based on exam results and achievements. See Tuition & scholarships.

items.q: I studied abroad. Can I apply?
items.a: Yes. International applicants apply directly to IBSU; the admissions team will help with document recognition.
